verdict.rationale: Plausible collects no personal data/no cookies and offers CSV export, self-hosting, and data-policy docs implying minimal retention, but there's no explicit documented mechanism for AI-native users to programmatically control retention windows or trigger deletion of specific data via API. missing for 10: explicit retention policy/duration documentation, API or dashboard controls for data deletion/right-to-erasure, and independent confirmation of these controls working.
